Definition: a light (i.e. window); dual double light, i.e. noon
BiblicalUsage: The word tsôhar is the Bible's way of saying a window, daylight at noon. In Genesis 6:16, A window shalt thou make to the ark, and it appears again in Deuteronomy 28:29.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the window in the ark and the noonday blindness of Deuteronomy both turn on whether we can see.
